treatments.name: Living Donor Kidney Transplant & Nephrectomy
treatments.description: Renal transplant surgery utilizing a compatible living donor graft, conducted in state-of-the-art sterile transplant suites with NOTTO authorization committee approval.
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Immediate urine output monitoring in Transplant ICU; discharge on day 7-8. Regular immunosuppressant blood trough titration for 2 weeks.

treatments.name: Robotic Radical Prostatectomy / Kidney Reconstruction
treatments.description: Da Vinci robot-assisted minimally invasive kidney reconstruction, partial nephrectomy, or radical prostatectomy with nerve-sparing technique.
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Minimal blood loss, catheter removal within 5-7 days, rapid return to walking within 24 hours.

treatments.name: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG)
treatments.description: Surgical procedure to restore normal blood flow to an obstructed coronary artery using an arterial or venous conduit graft (on-pump or off-pump beating heart).
commonIndications: Angina refractory to medication and angioplasty
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Initial ambulation by day 2; discharge on day 5-7. Fit-to-fly clearance usually issued after day 12-14 follow-up stitch check.

treatments.name: Robotic Total Knee Replacement (Unilateral / Bilateral)
treatments.description: Precision robotic or navigation-assisted replacement of damaged knee cartilage and bone surfaces with biocompatible titanium/cobalt-chrome implants.
commonIndications: Debilitating knee joint stiffness and chronic pain
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Walker assisted walking within 12-24 hours. Physiotherapy initiated immediately. Air travel permissible 10-14 days post-op.

treatments.name: Allogeneic / Autologous Bone Marrow Transplant (BMT)
treatments.description: High-dose conditioning chemotherapy followed by infusion of matched sibling or healthy blood stem cells in positive-pressure HEPA units.
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Strict isolation in sterile laminar airflow room during engraftment. Outpatient stay required for ongoing blood counts.

treatments.name: Minimally Invasive Craniotomy & Brain Tumor Resection
treatments.description: Image-guided neuronavigation or endoscopic microsurgical resection of intracranial benign or malignant lesions, preserving eloquent motor areas.
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Intensive neurological monitoring in Neuro-ICU for 48 hours. Stitch removal at 10-12 days before flight clearance.

treatments.name: Living Donor Liver Transplantation (LDLT)
treatments.description: Surgical excision of diseased liver and implantation of a partial liver graft harvested from an approved living related donor.
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Donor discharged in 6-8 days with rapid liver regeneration. Recipient observed in transplant ICU for 5 days.

treatments.name: Aesthetic Rhinoplasty & Facial Rejuvenation
treatments.description: Cosmetic and functional reshaping of nasal bones and cartilage to correct breathing airway obstructions and enhance facial harmony.
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Nasal splint removed after 6-7 days. Bruising resolves within 10 days; safe to fly after 1 week.

treatments.name: Advanced Laparoscopic Gastrointestinal & Hernia Repair
treatments.description: Keyhole laparoscopic anatomical repair with biocompatible dual-surface mesh reinforcement or laparoscopic cholecystectomy for gallstones.
treatments.recoveryHighlights: Discharge within 24-48 hours. Light walking the same evening. Normal travel permissible within 5-7 days.
